notes.title: Bug Fixes PLUS New content added to the soundtrack DLC
notes.notes:
Hello, Folks

We fixed some glitches that were preventing some players to understand one of the possible endings. Somewhere along the road, a great deal of dialogue went missing in 2 of the 5 endings. [b]ALL 5 ENDINGS[/b] are working properly now.

Also, we just added the in game loops to the soundtrack DLC available on the [b]Dark Arts Edition[/b]. They can be really good to listen while reading comic books.

Enjoy

notes.title: Kickstarter Backers will pay less for the game Face It.
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PPRJ1aQ.png[/img]

Hello, guys. Just let you know that we are running a campaign on Kickstarter to make Face It even better. The more funds we get, the better the game will be. Take a look at the Kickstarter page, play the Pilot Version for free, and please, consider pledging:  http://kck.st/1OBZBgy

Now that we got the greenlit, the plan is to release on Steam as early access, where the game should be for 4 to 6 months. Regarding the pricing, the Early Access will cost $12 on Steam. But if you pledge only $10 on Kickstarter you will get the very same Early Access Steam Key. If you wait until after the Early Access you will have to pay $15.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9vbyxsh.png[/img]


Also, if you are one of the first 25 to pledge $12, you will get the Early Bird Special Rewards. For the same price you would get on steam later, you will also get Soundtrack + Artbooks + Digital Interactive Grimoire + Ebook (All of them will be DLCs on Steam)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/W67lty3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Major Update with Fixes, Achievements and Steam Cards!
notes.notes:
After changing teams twice since release, we finally managed to make a major update.


[b]*Fixed the "White Screen of Death"[/b] and the [b]"Loading from Hell"[/b] that were prevent the game from running in some computers.

[b]*Changed the requirements[/b]. The game no longer needs Internet Explorer or .Net Framework installed in order to run.

* Added [b]Steam Cards[/b]

* Added [b] Story Oriented Steam Achievements[/b]

*Fixed some "storytelling bugs"

Enjoy

notes.title: IMPORTANT | For those players who weren't able to run the game
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Many of you have played Soul Gambler on Steam and gave us positive reviews and we are very thankful for it.

Some of you have had problems trying to run the game and even though it was a small amount of players, we know how unfair is not able to play a game you paid for. Whether were many people or few people, our duty is to help you as best we can.

Many of you already know the story behind the development of the [b]Soul Gambler[/b] and the reason of these bugs and how we cannot help to solve them and how that's why we are making the game from the scratch. Some of you, don't know this story and you just want to play the game you paid for and it's only fair. We must provide you what you paid for. 

[i] If you don’t want to read anymore text and just want to get the web version of the game, just skip the next paragraph and go to the instructions.[/i] 

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]
We cannot fully fix the current game version (PC - Windows), because it was built by another indie game studio based on the web technology available at the time. We, Tlön Studios, are creating an improved version, [b]Soul Gambler: Director's Cut[/b], on Unity 3D and  this project is been designed to be user-friendly and absolutely bugs free. Plus, everyone who bought the current version will receive the newer version (to be release on Christmas) for free as an update of the current one. If you can't play the current version of the game on your PC, we will give you access to the webgame, which is available on www.soulgambler.com - and is playable in almost every PC who runs a modern internet browser. [u]Soul Gambler for PC, iOS and Web, are exactly the same game.[/u]

[b]INSTRUCTIONS | to request full access to Soul Gambler (web version):[/b] 
[olist]
[*]Access the Soul Gambler’s store page on your Steam Client and take a screenshot like the one below, so we can check out your username and if you own the game;

[img]http://i.imgur.com/klDujkJ.png[/img]

[*]Access http://soulgambler.com/user/signup and register yourself on the website;
[*]Send us an e-mail to play@soulgambler.com requesting access to the web version, we need that you send us two things:
[*]The e-mail you used to register on the Soul Gambler's website;
[*]The screenshot you took on Step 1.
[*]We will give you full access to Soul Gambler and get back to you by e-mail on the very same day (24hs).
[/olist]

We are a small indie game studio trying to survive and making nice games and I'm sorry if we couldn't help you on the forums as often as we would like to. Don't worry we didn't forget you and we are very thankful and grateful for your support and for playing our game.

On Christmas, be ready for the [b]Soul Gambler - Director's Cut![/b]

If you have any other question or suggestion, regarding the game, please contact me directly on publisher@gamestorming.com.br

[b]Horacio Corral | CEO @ Tlön Studios & Gamestorming[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE | STEAM KEYS ARE AVAILABLE NOW on Indie Gala, IndieGameStand, Desura, Humble Bundle, Nuuvem and Splitplay
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have some good news about the Steam keys. See below:

[h1]IndieGameStand buyers[/h1]
For those who purchased [b]Soul Gambler[/b] on [b]IndieGameStand[/b] the Steam keys are available to be redeemed by everyone who paid more that $1 for the game. The Steam key is on your IGS Wallet.

[h1]Desura buyers[/h1]
For those who purchased [b]Soul Gambler[/b] on [b]Desura[/b], the Steam keys are available to be redeemed on the URL http://www.desura.com/collection - once logged, if you purchased the game on Desura, you'll be able to click on KEYS and receive your Steam key.

[h1]Kickstarter backers[/h1]
An e-mail with a Steam key has been sent to every back of the Kickstarter campaign. If you were a backer, please check your inbox;

[h1]IndieGala buyers[/h1]
Steam keys have been added to every purchase for more than $1;

[h1]Humble Bundle Store buyers[/h1]
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Humble Bundle Store;

[h1]Nuuvem buyers[/h1]
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Nuuvem;

[h1]Splitplay buyers[/h1]
The Steam keys were added to their system and are redeemable now. Please check your account at Splitplay.
________________________________________________________________

[h1]IMPORTANT INFO[/h1]
ONLY those who purchased the game, both bundle or standalone, will be able to redeem their Steam keys and ONLY on the store it was originally bought.

For example, you purchased Soul Gambler on Pay What You Want IndieGameStand's special promo, your Steam key is to be redeemed on IndieGameStand. 

Your Steam key will always be on the store were you paid for the game. 

This is how the online gamestores deal with game key distribution. Not our choice.
________________________________________________________________

If you have any question, doubt or suggestion, feel free to get in touch with me on publisher@gamestorming.com.br

I hope you all enjoy [b]Soul Gambler[/b]!

Thanks,

[b]HORACIO CORRAL[/b]
[b]CEO[/b] @ [url=fb.com/tlonstudios] Tlön Studios [/url] & [url=fb.com/GameStorming.Br] Gamestorming (Publisher)[/url]
